from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from urllib.error import HTTPError

class PageParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.tags = []
        self.text = {'title': '', 'h1': '', 'p': ''}
        self.active = None
        self.links = []
        self.meta = {}
        self.icons = []
        self.lang = None

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        self.tags.append(tag)
        if tag in self.text:
            self.active = tag
        if tag == 'html':
            self.lang = attrs.get('lang')
        if tag == 'a':
            self.links.append(attrs.get('href'))
        if tag == 'meta':
            self.meta[attrs.get('name')] = attrs.get('content')
        if tag == 'link' and attrs.get('rel') == 'icon':
            self.icons.append(attrs.get('href'))

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if self.active == tag:
            self.active = None

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.active:
            self.text[self.active] += data

base = 'http://127.0.0.1:3100'
for path, title, heading, paragraph, description, links in [
    ('/', 'Home Page', 'Home', 'Welcome to our Next.js application"'!'"', 'Welcome to our Next.js app', ['/about', '/contact']),
    ('/about', 'About Us', 'About', 'This is the about page of our Next.js application.', 'Learn more about us', ['/', '/contact']),
]:
    with urlopen(base + path) as response:
        assert response.status == 200
        parser = PageParser()
        parser.feed(response.read().decode())
    assert parser.text == {'title': title, 'h1': heading, 'p': paragraph}, parser.text
    assert parser.lang == 'en'
    assert parser.meta['description'] == description
    assert parser.meta['viewport'] == 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1'
    assert parser.icons == ['/favicon.ico']
    assert parser.links == links
    for tag in ['html', 'head', 'body', 'main', 'title']:
        assert parser.tags.count(tag) == 1, (tag, parser.tags.count(tag))
    with urlopen(Request(base + path, headers={'RSC': '1'})) as response:
        assert response.status == 200
        assert 'text/x-component' in response.headers['Content-Type']
        assert paragraph in response.read().decode()
    print(f'PASS {path}: HTML, content, metadata, links, and App Router RSC response')

try:
    urlopen(base + '/contact')
    raise AssertionError('Expected existing /contact link to remain a 404')
except HTTPError as error:
    assert error.code == 404, error.code
    print('PASS /contact: existing 404 behavior preserved')
PY"
